zh: 我登录不了，系统说我密码错了。
en: I can't {log in|sign in|log on|get in}. It says my password is wrong.

zh: 故障之后我们把这次发布回滚了。
en: We {rolled back|reverted|backed out} the release after the outage.

zh: 升级之前一定要备份你的文件。
en: Make sure you {back up|save|copy} your files before the upgrade.

zh: 昨晚服务器自己关机了。
en: The server {shut down|switched off|turned off|powered off} by itself last night.

zh: 你把充电器插上了吗？
en: Have you {plugged in|connected} the charger?

zh: IT部门今天下午在给我配置新电脑。
en: IT is {setting up|configuring} my new laptop this afternoon.

zh: 我昨天注册了免费试用。
en: I {signed up for|registered for} the free trial yesterday.

zh: 显示器开不了机。
en: The monitor won't {turn on|switch on|come on|power on|start|work}.

zh: 我终于弄明白构建为什么失败了。
en: I finally {figured out|worked out|found out} why the build was failing.

zh: 今天早上网站宕机了两个小时。
en: The website {went down|was down} for two hours this morning.

zh: 往下滚动，你就能看到下载按钮。
en: If you {scroll down}, you'll see the download button.

zh: 你能帮我把议程打印出来吗？
en: Could you {print out|print off|print} the agenda for me?

zh: 她连续三次输错了密码。
en: She {typed in|entered|put in|keyed in|typed} the wrong password three times.

zh: 你可以在设置里选择退订营销邮件。
en: You can {opt out of|unsubscribe from|turn off|switch off|stop|disable|block} marketing emails in your settings.

zh: 我们会在六月前逐步淘汰旧系统。
en: We're {phasing out|retiring|replacing|removing|decommissioning} the old system by June.

zh: 他已经把笔记本电脑连到大屏幕上了。
en: He's {hooked up|connected} the laptop to the big screen.

zh: 视频通话的时候我的电脑老是卡死。
en: My laptop keeps {freezing up|freezing|crashing|locking up|hanging} during video calls.

zh: 测试的时候我们遇到了几个程序错误。
en: We {ran into|came across|hit|found} a few bugs during testing.

zh: 我每次打开这个应用都会弹出一条错误信息。
en: An error message {pops up|comes up|appears|shows up} every time I open the app.

zh: 办公室的打印机老是出毛病。
en: The office printer keeps {playing up|acting up|jamming|breaking|breaking down|failing}.

zh: 服务器故障让我们的进度推迟了一周。
en: The server outage has {set back|put back|held up|delayed} our schedule by a week.

zh: 开机箱之前先把服务器关掉。
en: {Power down|Shut down|Turn off|Switch off} the server before you open the case.

zh: 升级的时候我们遇到了一些问题。
en: We {ran into|came up against|came across|encountered|hit|had} a few problems during the upgrade.

zh: 新系统将在明年分阶段推行。
en: The new system will be {phased in|rolled out|introduced} over the next year.

zh: 发送之前把文件压缩一下。
en: {Zip up|Zip|Compress} the files before you send them.

zh: 文件没保存上，我得从头再来。
en: The file didn't save, so I have to {start over|start again|begin again}.

zh: 我的笔记本电脑开机要花五分钟。
en: My laptop takes five minutes to {start up|boot up|start|boot|load}.

zh: 我搞不明白打印机为什么老卡纸。
en: I can't {figure out|work out|understand} why the printer keeps jamming.

zh: 我手机快没电了。
en: My phone battery is {running down|running out|running low|going flat|dying}.

zh: 我想暂时还是继续用我的旧手机吧。
en: I think I'll {stick with|stay with|keep} my old phone for now.

zh: 服务器的CPU一直满负荷运行。
en: The server's CPU has been {maxed out} all morning.

zh: 代码评审之前我得把代码整理一下。
en: I need to {tidy up|clean up} my code before the review.

zh: 我合上盖子以后，笔记本还是一直开着。
en: My laptop {stays on|stays awake} even when I close the lid.

zh: 你能把投影仪接上吗？
en: Can you {hook up|connect|plug in|set up} the projector?

zh: 我怎样才能让笔记本电脑跑得快一点？
en: How can I {speed up} my laptop?

zh: 下个月我们会向全体员工推出新系统。
en: We're {rolling out|launching|releasing|introducing|deploying} the new system to all staff next month.

zh: 不懂的话就别乱动设置。
en: Don't {mess around|mess about|muck around|fiddle around|play around} with the settings if you don't understand them.

zh: 我们还需要解决几个小问题。
en: We still need to {iron out|sort out|fix|resolve} a few small issues.

zh: 我的电脑开机要五分钟。
en: My laptop takes five minutes to {boot up|start up|start|boot|load}.

zh: 我们还没找到这个漏洞的确切原因。
en: We still haven't {pinned down|nailed down|identified|worked out|found} the exact cause of the bug.

zh: 我最近一直在试用新的AI工具。
en: I've been {playing around|messing around|mucking around|experimenting|playing} with the new AI tools.

zh: 开会前先把投影仪打开。
en: {Power up|Turn on|Switch on|Start up|Fire up} the projector before the meeting starts.

zh: 你能把上个月的销售数据调出来吗？
en: Can you {pull up|bring up|call up|open|find} last month's sales figures?

zh: 你能帮我把投影仪的电源插上吗？
en: Can you {plug in} the projector for me?

zh: 我们在云迁移方面落后于竞争对手。
en: We're {lagging behind|falling behind|behind} our competitors on cloud migration.

zh: 我想试试那个新应用。
en: I want to {try out|test out|test|try} the new app.

zh: 屏幕上老是弹出这个错误提示。
en: This error message keeps {popping up|coming up|appearing|showing up} on my screen.

zh: IT昨天把我的网络问题解决了。
en: IT {sorted out|fixed|solved|resolved} my wifi problem yesterday.

zh: 用完公用电脑记得退出账号。
en: Remember to {sign out|log out|log off} when you finish on a shared computer.

zh: 我们需要扩大服务器容量来应对流量高峰。
en: We need to {scale up|increase|expand|boost} our server capacity for the traffic peak.

zh: 输错三次密码后，我的账户被锁了。
en: After three wrong passwords, I was {locked out} of my account.

zh: 我的笔记本电脑又出毛病了。
en: My laptop's {playing up|acting up} again.

zh: 下班前请记得退出系统。
en: Please {log off|log out|sign out} before you go home.

zh: 四月份我们换成了新的工资系统。
en: We {switched over|switched|moved|changed over|migrated} to the new payroll system in April.

zh: 今天早上网站宕机了。
en: The website {went down|crashed} this morning.
